`pnpm build` passes its JavaScript syntax checks. The app is configured for port 9100 in [package.json](/private/var/folders/7z/5mtgxwxx4zs9ppgzm942gbmh0000gn/T/workspace.MRhOcK/app/package.json) and [server.mjs](/private/var/folders/7z/5mtgxwxx4zs9ppgzm942gbmh0000gn/T/workspace.MRhOcK/app/server.mjs).

I couldn’t verify it in a browser: Portly fails to launch with macOS `kLSNoExecutableErr`, and the workspace instructions require Portly to start the app. Dependency installation also hit registry DNS errors, so the app uses native JavaScript and has no external dependencies.
